what: Checks written by Shay Green that hold an audio unit to what a console does.
why: Each carries a checksum its author took on real hardware, so what it settles is settled by a measurement rather than by agreeing with another implementation. None of these files is carried here. A copy you already own goes in the spc directory of this project or in any directory named by SSMP_SPC_DIR.
author: Shay Green

checks.name: initial_regs.spc
checks.covers: the six processor registers, all sixteen addresses that are not memory, and the sound generator's whole register file

checks.name: initial_in_ports.spc
checks.covers: the four ports, read as the very first thing the program does

checks.name: full_ram.spc
checks.covers: every byte of memory, the stack page, the echo buffer, and the three bytes under the stack pointer
